name: Van Helsing

crownPassive.name: Garlic and the Host
crownPassive.text: All healing, on both sides, is reduced by 1. No card can come back from death or cheat it: returns, revivals and 'survives on X health' effects don't work.

bond.name: Crew of Light
bond.text: +1 Attack for each other Gothic hero you field.

actions.name: Attack
actions.text: Standard attack: a Ranged attack for his Attack.

actions.name: Blood transfusion
actions.text: He loses 2 Health, and one of your other heroes, chosen at random, heals 3. The heal stops working at Nightfall, but he still loses the Health.

rules: Blocked by his crown passive: Victor returning a tale-mate, Friar Tuck returning front-rank cards, the Draught of the Cauldron, Vasilisa's crown passive, Red Riding Hood's bond, and a card swallowed by the Wolf coming back out.
From the crown his own Blood transfusion heals 2, not 3.
notes: High damage, low healing: the Gothic opposite of Albion.
